findings.source_quote: I give to God, but I can only give to Him only Himself as He has given Himself to me.
findings.suggested_fix: 我献给上帝的，唯有祂自己——正如祂已将自己赐给我。
findings.translation_quote: 我把自己献给上帝，但我所能献给祂的，只有祂自己——正如祂已把自己赐给我。

findings.source_quote: God gives to me my new self in Christ.
findings.suggested_fix: 上帝把我在基督里新的自己赐给我。
findings.translation_quote: 上帝把我在基督里的新生命赐给我。
